title: C-STREET SMALL BUSINESS WEEKEND 2026
seo_title: C-Street Small Business Weekend 2026 in Springfield, MO
description: C-Street Small Business Weekend is a three-day shopping event where you browse local brick-and-mortar shops for gifts, many made locally, and buy them on the spot. You can also walk the historic district and have dinner and drinks at nearby local restaurants. It starts Friday, November 27, 2026 at 10:00 AM at Historic C-Street, 299 E Commercial St, Springfield, MO; hours vary by business, so check each shop's social media.
address: 299 E Commercial St, Springfield, MO 65803-2939, United States, Springfield, MO
